place: Gardens of Eden, Cherngtalay, Choeng Thale, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand
title: Eden Residences — 4-Bedroom Sea-View Penthouse with Rooftop Pool — C403
blurb: A single, top-floor penthouse in the first phase of Gardens of Eden — 385 m² of four-bedroom living crowned by a private rooftop pool with an open sea and mountain horizon. Set on the fourth floor with its own roof level, 50 metres from Bang Tao Beach, inside a 33-acre parkland resort. THB 123,200,000.
detail:
C403 is one penthouse — the top of Building C in Eden Residences, the opening phase of Gardens of Eden on Phuket's Bang Tao coast. It occupies the fourth floor and its own private roof, so the whole home reads as a single, uninterrupted level of living crowned by a rooftop retreat.

The layout totals 385 m²: 177 m² of internal space, a 43 m² balcony running off the living level, and a 165 m² roof terrace above. Four bedrooms — a master suite plus three further bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, alongside a guest powder room — open around a wraparound living, dining and kitchen space framed floor-to-ceiling in glass, with sea and garden views to two aspects.

The roof is the signature. A private infinity pool sits at the edge of a broad stone terrace with sun loungers, a shaded lounge and mature planting, looking out over the treetops to the beach, the bay and the hills beyond — a rooftop that belongs to this home alone.

The residence is handed over finished and fitted — walls, floors, lighting, air-conditioning, sanitary ware, a fully fitted kitchen and built-in wardrobes — with optional furniture packages available. It sits within the wider Gardens of Eden estate: 122,000 m² of grounds, 70% of it open parkland, lakes and gardens, with a wellness centre, six swimming pools, eight restaurants, two kids' clubs, a business centre and supermarket, car-free surroundings and free underground parking. The beach is 50 metres away and Laguna Park a five-minute walk.

Eden Residences completes in 2026. The price of THB 123,200,000 is quoted on the developer's standard terms — a leasehold or sale-and-purchase agreement, with freehold title available on request — and a staged construction payment plan applies.

Return outlook (developer projections). The developer publishes an indicative price path for this unit over a roughly one-year horizon to handover: THB 123,200,000 at launch (November 2025, with about 80% of Phase 1 sold), rising to THB 135,520,000 at the finishing and furnishing stage (August 2026) and THB 149,072,000 on handover (December 2026) — an uplift of around 20%, with a further ~10% attributed to completion of the park landscaping. A rental yield of approximately 8% per year is also projected. These are the developer's own estimates, not guaranteed returns; actual capital growth and rental income depend on market conditions.
